```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
```

# 1. Open data
```{r}
data_lanuza <- read_delim(file="2. Traits/2.1. Voj_Lan_floral_diameter/Raw/data_Lanuza_et_al_2023_all_sp.csv")
#data from Lanuza et al., 2023 - functional ecology

data_voj <- read_delim(file="2. Traits/2.1. Voj_Lan_floral_diameter/Raw/data_Vojtko_et_al_2022_alpinedataset.csv")
#data from Vojtko et al., 2022 - new phytol

top_sp <- read_delim(file="2. Traits/2.1. Voj_Lan_floral_diameter/Raw/List_1pc_most_frequent_species.csv") %>% 
  dplyr::select(-x) %>% 
  rename(key = nom_eni_fusion_trait_code) #1% sp les plus fréquentes dans data 500ENI

key <- read_delim(file="2. Traits/2.1. Voj_Lan_floral_diameter/Raw/key_500_ENI_name_species.csv") %>% 
  dplyr::select(-1)
# key between code names and species, genus, family, synonyms etc
```

# 2. Create the key and select columns of interest for both datasets

The key is 4 letters of the genus and 7 letters of the species

For species present in both datasets I calculate the mean of the trait
```{r}
lanuza_clean <- data_lanuza %>%  
  mutate(species=toupper(Species_all)) %>% 
  separate(species,sep=" ",c("Genre","Sp")) %>% 
  mutate(genus=str_sub(Genre, 1, 4))%>% 
  mutate(sp=str_sub(Sp, 1, 7)) %>% 
  mutate(key= paste(genus,sp,sep="")) %>% 
  dplyr::select(Species_all,Genre,Sp,key,Floral_unit_width)%>% 
  rename(Plant_species=Species_all,
         floral_diameter=Floral_unit_width)

vojtko_clean <- data_voj %>% 
  mutate(species=toupper(Plant_species)) %>% 
  separate(species,sep=" ",c("Genre","Sp")) %>% 
  mutate(genus=str_sub(Genre, 1, 4))%>% 
  mutate(sp=str_sub(Sp, 1, 7)) %>% 
  mutate(key= paste(genus,sp,sep="")) %>% 
  dplyr::select(Plant_species,Genre,Sp,key,Display_size_mm)  %>%  
  rename(floral_diameter=Display_size_mm)

tot_clean <- vojtko_clean %>% 
  rbind(lanuza_clean) %>% 
  group_by(Plant_species,Genre,Sp,key) %>% 
  summarise_all(mean)
```

 
# 3. Remove the Poaceae species from the 1% in order to join with floral traits data
```{r}
un_prcnt_sans_poaceae <-  top_sp %>% 
  left_join(key) %>% 
  filter(FAMILLE!="Poaceae") %>% 
  dplyr::select(key,FAMILLE) %>% 
  distinct()
```

It leaves 120 species that are not Poaceaes

# 4. Select the species of the 1% without Poaceae and ferns
```{r}
tot_clean_eni <-  tot_clean %>% 
  filter(key %in% un_prcnt_sans_poaceae$key)

sp_manquantes <-  un_prcnt_sans_poaceae %>% 
  filter(!key %in% tot_clean_eni$key) %>% 
  left_join(key) %>% 
  dplyr::select(key,nom_eni) %>% 
  distinct()


#write.csv(sp_manquantes,file="2. Traits/2.1. Voj_Lan_floral_diameter/Processed/missing_sp_for_floral_diameter.csv")
#write.csv(tot_clean_eni,file="2. Traits/2.1. Voj_Lan_floral_diameter/Processed/floral_diameter.csv")
```
